model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the monthly values (labeled as “/%/” on the vertical axis, though the unit is likely a mislabel and should represent a count or monetary value) for three consecutive years — 2022 (blue), 2023 (orange), and 2024 (gray) — across the twelve months of the year, labeled in Roman numerals I through XII on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis ranges from 0 to 140,000 in increments of 20,000. Each month features a grouped set of three bars, one per year, allowing for year-over-year comparison. Values fluctuate across months and years: for instance, March (III) shows the highest value in 2024 (~125,000), while August (VIII) shows the lowest across all years (~80,000 in 2022). In general, 2024 values are higher than 2022 and 2023 in most months, with notable peaks in March and December. The chart does not show a consistent upward or downward trend across months within a single year, suggesting seasonal or irregular variation. The legend on the right clearly distinguishes the years by color.
